name: Zen Lotus Pond
subtitle: Backyard lotus water garden
lede: Filtered, jasmine-flanked lotus water garden with Buddha and simple moving water.
nextAction: Choose and verify the permanent pond solution before sizing the permanent pump and filter.
goals: Clean moving water with minimal visible algae and larvae
Professional compact design framed by jasmine and Buddha
Keep routine maintenance small and predictable

siteConstraints.climate: Very hot summer climate; temperatures can reach about 110°F
siteConstraints.preferredWaterMovement: Gentle bubbler or low fountain to limit evaporation
siteConstraints.maintenanceTarget: A few minutes weekly in hot weather plus roughly 10–15 minutes monthly for filter cleaning as needed

phases.name: Lotus Nursery
phases.summary: Establish three seed-grown lotus seedlings in the temporary nursery.

phases.name: Pond Decision
phases.summary: Select the permanent pond solution and verify that it is suitable for long-term water use.

candidates.name: Existing raised planter conversion
candidates.notes: Already lined, but framing, bracing, liner type, bottom support and continuous hydrostatic load must be verified before conversion.

candidates.name: Algreen Manhattan rectangular planter pond
candidates.notes: Preferred over the Pennington 50-gallon option for appearance and depth; not yet recorded as purchased.

candidates.name: Pennington 50-gallon Aquagarden
candidates.notes: All-in-one option considered, but less preferred aesthetically than the Algreen Manhattan.

candidates.name: Separate 4 ft × 2 ft × 2 ft raised pond
candidates.notes: Do not purchase/build until the other permanent pond options are resolved.

phases.name: Pump + Filter + Fountain
phases.summary: Size the circulation and filtration system after final pond volume is known.
requirements: Simple low fountain or bubbler return
notes: UV clarifier is optional and should be added only if persistent green-water algae becomes a problem.
The existing low-cost smartpond kit is for the small nursery, not the permanent pond.

phases.name: Structure / Liner
phases.summary: Reinforce the pond shell or replace/add pond-grade liner only if the selected permanent pond solution requires it.

phases.name: Jasmine
phases.summary: Frame the pond with two jasmine planters and black trellises using intentionally light foliage density.

phases.name: Lotus + Buddha
phases.summary: Place lotus on one side, Buddha beside the lotus, fountain toward the opposite side, and preserve open reflective water.

phases.name: Pothos
phases.summary: Use trailing pothos only in locations protected from intense direct summer sun.

phases.name: Lighting
phases.summary: Add restrained warm accent lighting after the pond system is stable.

decisions.decision: Start fishless; fish are not required.
Removed; use a simple fountain or bubbler return.
Optional later if persistent green-water algae warrants it.
Jasmine — Pond — Jasmine in one row, with lighter foliage density.
Use only where protected from severe direct summer sun.

maintenance.task: Remove visible debris/string algae and check water level
